stem: A diagnostic test has sensitivity of 90 percent and specificity of 89 percent. Which statement is correct?

options.text: It identifies 90 percent of people who have the disease as test-positive
It identifies 90 percent of people without the disease as test-negative
Its positive predictive value is always 90 percent
Its negative predictive value is always 89 percent

explanation: Sensitivity is the proportion of people with the disease who test positive. Specificity is the proportion of people without the disease who test negative. Predictive values depend on disease prevalence.
rationale: Sensitivity is the proportion of people with the disease who test positive. Specificity is the proportion of people without the disease who test negative. Predictive values depend on disease prevalence.
